import itertools, sys

def is_costas(p):
    n=len(p)
    seen=set()
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1,n):
            dr=p[j]-p[i]
            dc=j-i
            if (dr,dc) in seen:
                return False
            seen.add((dr,dc))
    return True

n=11
# use backtracking
perm=[-1]*n
used=set()

def backtrack(col):
    if col==n:
        print('found',perm)
        sys.exit()
    for r in range(n):
        if r in used:
            continue
        # check partial
        ok=True
        for c2 in range(col):
            dr=r-perm[c2]
            dc=col-c2
            # check against earlier pairs
            for c3 in range(c2):
                dr2=perm[c2]-perm[c3]
                dc2=c2-c3
                if (dr,dc)==(dr2,dc2):
                    ok=False;break
            if not ok:
                break
        if not ok:
            continue
        perm[col]=r; used.add(r)
        backtrack(col+1)
        used.remove(r)
        perm[col]=-1
